archetypes.label: Ball hunters
archetypes.blurb: Press first, ask later — elite pressure and forced-turnover volume, minimal build-up duty.

archetypes.label: Ball-playing anchors
archetypes.blurb: High pass volume at high completion, line-breaking from deep; their rare shots are set-piece headers.

archetypes.label: Box predators
archetypes.blurb: Top of the food chain for xG, shots and threat — they live between the posts and the penalty spot.
traits: top of the xG food chain

archetypes.label: Touchline burners
archetypes.blurb: Pace, width and crosses — receive in behind and attack the byline.

archetypes.label: Midfield metronomes
archetypes.blurb: Volume passers who never stop offering — the tempo-setters covering the most grass.

archetypes.label: Dead-ball architects
archetypes.blurb: Corners, free kicks and whipped deliveries — the set-piece and cross-volume specialists.
traits: takes the corners and free kicks

archetypes.label: Quiet engines
archetypes.blurb: Few touches, safe ball, high speed — the shift-runners who stretch play off the radar.

archetypes.label: Chaos dribblers
archetypes.blurb: Take-ons, carries and pockets — the ones who break structure with the ball glued to their boot.

teamStyles.label: Possession architects
teamStyles.blurb: High completed-pass volume, patient build-up, chances without chasing.

teamStyles.label: High-press gamblers
teamStyles.blurb: Enormous pressing numbers and enormous shots conceded — chaos as a strategy.

teamStyles.label: Low-block survivors
teamStyles.blurb: Below average in every attacking metric — organized, compact, waiting.

teamStyles.label: Vertical aggressors
teamStyles.blurb: Line breaks, runs in behind and shot volume — fastest route to goal wins.
